- **EMET:** To-You my-heart says, "Seek My-face." Your-face, YHWH, I-seek.
- **LOGOS:** You have said, "Seek My face." My heart says to You, "Your face, LORD, do I seek."

## 27:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **LOGOS:** Hide not Your face from me. Turn not Your servant away in anger, O You who have been my help. Cast me not off; forsake me not, O God of my salvation!
- **PNEUMA:** Do not turn Your back on me. Do not reject Your servant in anger. You have always been my helper. Don't leave me now; don't abandon me, O God of my salvation!
